entries.after: 2026-11-07 current balance settings registered without numeric changes
entries.reason: Introduce reproducible balance versioning for future measurements.
entries.expected_impact: No gameplay change. Future logs can be separated and compared by balance version and configuration hash.

entries.before: No position-dependent enemy attack, wall-impact brittle state, or non-stacking protection resonance
entries.after: Added swarm_amplifier, impact_brittle, and protection_resonator with initial JSON-tunable parameters and authored validation stages; live validation set the reachable brittle wall-impact threshold to 6
entries.reason: Make moving, separating, and banking enemies into walls meaningful alternatives to direct damage.
entries.expected_impact: More shots choose displacement and target order; actual impact must be judged with fixed-condition telemetry and human playtests.

entries.before: Board-control enemies were available in definitions and four validation-oriented stages, but the requested 6/8/10-enemy authored progression set was absent.
entries.after: Added six authored Normal stages: two difficulty-1 six-enemy introductions, two difficulty-2 eight-enemy applications, and two difficulty-3 ten-enemy combinations.
entries.reason: Introduce separating, wall-impact and protection-breaking decisions into the normal run without changing enemy abilities or the existing stage selector.
entries.expected_impact: Board-control decisions appear from early to late progress while legacy Normal, MidBoss and Boss stages remain eligible; clear rate and shot count require fixed-condition measurement.

entries.before: Several board-control stage enemies used edge-biased positions, including two normal enemies extending 0.4 units beyond the field and three stages with less than the requested pocket safety margin.
entries.after: Moved board-control stage enemies toward the table center, preserved wall-side X positions for impact-brittle enemies, and guaranteed more than 6.0 units of clearance beyond enemy and pocket radii across all stages.
entries.reason: Prevent enemy balls from appearing outside the playable surface or too close to pocket mouths while retaining each stage's board-control decision.
entries.expected_impact: Cleaner initial presentation and safer shot access; dense groups are slightly more central, while impact-brittle wall routes remain available.
